INSTALLATION.ALERTING_INFO: Set up email notifications as an installer when the FEMS is offline for a certain period of time or reports an error. The message is sent to the email address provided during commissioning.

GENSET.EMERGENCY_POWER_FUNCTION: Should the emergency power Genset function be activated?
GENSET.BATTERY_CHARGING: Enable battery charging from the Genset?
GENSET.MAX_POWER_DESCRIPTION: Percentage of the available Genset power with which the battery is to be charged.
GENSET.CHARGE_SOC_START: Battery charge level for starting the Genset
GENSET.CHARGE_SOC_START_DESCRIPTION: State of charge of the battery at which the Genset is started.
GENSET.CHARGE_SOC_END: Battery charge level for stopping the Genset
GENSET.CHARGE_SOC_END_DESCRIPTION: State of charge of the battery at which the Genset is stopped.
